skill.name: pptx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, and validate PowerPoint .pptx files using HTML-to-PPTX, OOXML editing, thumbnail generation, and template workflows.
skill.summary: Create and modify PowerPoint presentations with HTML conversion, OOXML access, validation, and thumbnails.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms unsafe archive extraction with zipfile.extractall on Office archives and privilege-escalating sudo install guidance. Most other static hits are false positives from OOXML namespace URLs, Markdown backticks, XML examples, JavaScript template literals, and local validation code. Static review was capped at 400/508 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 108 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Unsafe ZIP extraction of Office documents
remediation.suggestion: Replace every extractall call with safe member extraction that rejects absolute paths, drive prefixes, symlinks, and paths escaping the destination directory.
Remove sudo apt-get commands from skill instructions and require users to install system packages manually outside autonomous agent execution.

remediation.issue: External document converters run on local presentation files
remediation.suggestion: Document sandbox expectations for LibreOffice, Poppler, and other converters when handling untrusted PPTX input.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint automation often needs both visual layout control and low-level file access. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PPTX creation, template editing, validation, and thumbnails.
actual_capabilities: Create new PowerPoint decks from HTML slide layouts with PptxGenJS.
Unpack, edit, validate, and repack PPTX files through Office Open XML workflows.
Extract template text and slide structure for guided reuse.
Generate thumbnail grids to review slide layout, spacing, and visual errors.
Replace template text while preserving paragraph styling and bullet metadata.
Rearrange, duplicate, or delete slides with helper scripts.
limitations: Requires local Python, Node.js, and presentation conversion dependencies.
Raw OOXML edits can corrupt files if validation is skipped.
Thumbnail generation depends on LibreOffice and Poppler availability.
The included scripts process local files and should not be used on untrusted archives without sandboxing.

use_cases.title: Build a New Slide Deck
use_cases.description: Create a polished presentation from an outline using HTML layouts, charts, notes, and visual validation.

use_cases.title: Adapt an Existing Template
use_cases.description: Analyze template slides, map content to available designs, replace text, and preserve the original style.

use_cases.title: Repair and Inspect PPTX Files
use_cases.description: Unpack a presentation, inspect OOXML relationships, fix structure issues, validate, and rebuild the file.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint deck about [topic]. Use a clear visual hierarchy, speaker notes, and a thumbnail review step.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Brand Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this template presentation, summarize its layout patterns, then create a new deck for [audience] using the closest matching slide designs.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the attached PPTX with the revised messaging below. Preserve fonts, colors, bullets, notes, and template structure where possible.

prompt_templates.title: Validate OOXML Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this PPTX at the OOXML level, identify broken relationships or invalid slide references, fix them, validate the result, and explain the changes.

output_examples.input: A product launch outline with target audience, key messages, and brand colors.
output_examples.output: A completed presentation with title, agenda, market context, product value, rollout plan, and closing slides.

output_examples.input: An existing template deck and replacement text for each slide.
output_examples.output: A revised deck that keeps the original layouts, updates text, and reports any slides that need manual visual review.

output_examples.input: A PPTX file with broken media references after manual editing.
output_examples.output: A validation summary that identifies missing relationships, fixes reachable references, and flags unresolved assets.

best_practices: Generate thumbnails after each major layout change and inspect them before delivery.
Keep a backup copy before unpacking or editing raw OOXML files.
Validate after every OOXML edit instead of waiting until the final package step.
anti_patterns: Do not skip validation when packing edited OOXML back into a PPTX file.
Do not use arbitrary fonts unless they are installed in the target environment.
Do not process untrusted PPTX archives outside a sandboxed workspace.

faq.question: Can this skill create a new PowerPoint file from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses HTML slide layouts and PptxGenJS to build new PPTX presentations.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing PPTX template?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect template slides, map new content to layouts, replace text, and preserve styling.

faq.question: Does it support speaker notes and comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The OOXML workflow can inspect and edit notes, comments, layouts, masters, and media files.

faq.question: What dependencies are needed?
faq.answer: The workflows may require Python packages, Node.js packages, LibreOffice, Poppler, and Playwright.

faq.question: Is raw OOXML editing safe?
faq.answer: It is powerful but fragile. Always keep backups and validate after each XML change.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
